verdict.rationale: First-party docs say LangSmith can be hosted in your own infrastructure for observability, evaluation and prompt engineering, keeping trace data in your environment. Further docs describe Helm configurations and a self-hosted release policy, and community comments preferring local tools do not concretely contradict this. Missing for 10: installation and system-requirement detail or licensing/tier terms for self-hosting, and independent hands-on corroboration of a working self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Host an instance of LangSmith in your own infrastructure for observability, evaluation, and prompt engineering.
Self-hosted LangSmith runs the LangSmith platform in your own infrastructure so that trace and operational data stay in your environment.
Tune the Agent Server for self-hosted deployments—write load, read load, and example Helm configurations for different load patterns.
